root_cause: The external heartbeat transport was live and authenticated, but the latency-critical revenue spine still synchronously called powerhouse_refresh_revenue_attribution_snapshot_v1(). Runtime mux also scheduled the same attribution refresh at minutes 7/22/37/52, exactly overlapping the external heartbeat schedule 2/7/12/.../57. Production logs showed ECHECKOUTTIMEOUT, lock timeout and statement timeout while the heartbeat stack was inside attribution refresh.
prevention: The commercial heartbeat reads only a cached attribution receipt. Full attribution materialization remains fail-closed maintenance owned by the runtime mux on 4/19/34/49. The mux cron excludes both legacy pg_cron heartbeat slots (0 mod 5) and external heartbeat slots (2 mod 5), and formerly unreachable mux tasks are shifted to reachable non-heartbeat slots.
